units.source_text: 信上写明月日，又附加数行：

en.t: The letter clearly stated the month and day, and added a few more lines:

units.source_text: “你等不须知道我命终之月日。

en.t: You need not know the month and day when my life will end.

units.source_text: 古来惯例，居丧必着麻衣，

en.t: According to custom from ancient times, one must wear hempen mourning clothes while in mourning,
but this too is quite unnecessary.

units.source_text: 你只须将自己看作神佛化身，

en.t: You need only regard yourself as an incarnation of the gods and buddhas,

units.source_text: 而为我这老法师多做功德可矣。

en.t: and do many meritorious deeds for this old priest, and that will be enough.

units.source_text: 既享现世之乐，勿忘后世之事！

en.t: Though you enjoy the pleasures of this present world, do not forget the affairs of the next!

units.source_text: 但能成遂往生极乐之愿，

en.t: If only the wish to be reborn in the Pure Land can be fulfilled,
there will surely be a time when we meet again.

units.source_text: 你须记住：将来离此娑婆世界，

en.t: Remember this: in the future, when you leave this saha world,

units.source_text: 到达彼岸净土，即可重新聚首。”

en.t: and reach the Pure Land on the farther shore, we can be reunited once more.

units.source_text: 又把在住吉大寺所陈愿文装在一口沉香木大箱子里，

en.t: He also placed the vow text he had presented at the great temple of Sumiyoshi inside a large agarwood box,
sealed it, and sent it along with the letter.
